name: Madrone Canyon
title: Window Cleaning in Madrone Canyon, Bee Cave | CleanzATX
description: Window cleaning for Madrone Canyon homes in Bee Cave. Pure water exterior glass at $10 per window, built for gated custom homesites near Spanish Oaks.
intro: Madrone Canyon is a private gated community of custom homesites next to Spanish Oaks, reached off Twin Peaks Trace. CleanzATX cleans the windows of homes here, with pure water, no ladders on the outside and a plan for your gate.

sections.h2: What Madrone Canyon homes are like
paragraphs: Madrone Canyon has about 110 homesites, and the developer calls them private gated custom homesites next to Spanish Oaks. Streets such as Twin Peaks Trace and Madrone Tree Lane wind through the hills, and prices run from about $1.5M to $4M. Custom means every house is different, with its own window layout, roof pitch and mix of stone and stucco.
The community has its own HOA, separate from the Spanish Oaks POA, so rules on contractors and hours come from Madrone Canyon. We keep to normal daytime hours and work quietly.

sections.h2: What Madrone Canyon windows deal with
paragraphs: The hills mean mature tree cover on a lot of these sites. That brings spider webs, leaf litter and oak pollen into screens and window tracks, and it leaves a green film on the lower panes after a damp spring. Cedar pollen in winter does the same on the south and west sides.

Homes built into a slope often have glass at odd heights, with walkout levels below the main floor. Our water fed poles reach three stories from the ground, so a daylight basement window and a high gable pane get the same treatment.

Send the gate code or tell us who to call before the visit. The community sits close to Spanish Oaks and the Bee Cave Road corridor, so we can often pair a Madrone Canyon job with another one in the area and save you a trip fee. If your house has a tile or metal roof, ask about a roof soft wash, which we do at 12V low pressure.
A 4,000 square foot home is about $400 for exterior windows at $0.10 per sq ft. Expect roughly three to four hours on site for the exterior, plus about two hours for interior glass cleaned by hand.

why: Custom homes with odd window heights are handled from the ground.
Tree cover means we clean tracks and screens, not just glass.
We coordinate with the community gate before we arrive.

faq.q: Does Madrone Canyon have its own rules for contractors?
faq.a: The community has its own HOA. Share any contractor rules with us when you request a quote and we follow them. We keep to normal daytime hours and clean up before we leave.

faq.q: How much for a typical Madrone Canyon home?
faq.a: Outside glass runs $10 per window or about $0.10 per sq ft, so a 4,000 square foot Madrone Canyon house comes to roughly $400. Add the inside at $15 per window. Our minimum is $200.

faq.q: Will you clean windows on a sloped, walkout lot?
faq.a: Yes. Water fed poles reach up to three stories from the ground, so lower walkout glass and high gable windows are covered without setting ladders against the exterior walls.

faq.q: Can you wash a tile or metal roof here?
faq.a: Yes, with a 12V soft wash system from $0.25 per sq ft, $400 minimum. It is low pressure, so tile and finishes are not blasted. Many owners pair it with a house wash.
On Triannual, Quarterly and Every 2 Months plans you get the 7 day rain guarantee. On any job, text a photo within 7 days and we come back free when we are in the area.
